summary.text: Rich Nalevanko is a Republican state representative from Cheshire District 9 in the New Hampshire House of Representatives, where he has served since December 2024, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Richard Nalevanko assumed office in the New Hampshire House of Representatives on December 4, 2024, succeeding Daniel Eaton, a Democrat.
He advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3 ballot for Cheshire 9, where James Gruber is also a candidate.
